svg.title: AuthCore
svg.desc: AuthCore — Multi-tenant OAuth2 and OpenID Connect authorization server. Refresh tokens rotate with reuse detection, signing keys and client secrets rotate while it runs, and a revoked token stops working immediately. 65 tests · Testcontainers.
